data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding opened the year at GBP 1,015.305m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small net prior-year release of approximately GBP 4.55m (0.45% of opening reserves), driven largely by favourable claims development and reserve releases in casualty lines and programme reinsurance recoveries; 2017 hurricane reserves (Harvey/Irma/Maria) were described as adequate. The syndicate experienced multiple 2018 natural catastrophe events (Florence, Michael, Jebi, Trami, Camp fire) but these were reported to be within modelled expectations and materially reduced by a targeted reinsurance programme. Note: a reinsurance-to-close (Syndicate 2255) transaction during the year and reinsurance flows may distort per-line movements.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) figure derived from the gross claims development triangle because no explicit gross 'movement in prior years' note was found. A Reinsurance-To-Close (Syndicate 2255) transaction was completed with assets and liabilities transferred on 1 Jan 2018, which may materially distort per-year movements and the triangle; this reduces confidence in per-line and PYD allocations. Some narrative quotes refer to net releases (after reinsurance); gross PYD was estimated from the triangle as no gross movement line was provided.
